target.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users generating video with xAI could configure provider request policy, such as custom headers or proxy settings, but xAI video generation requests ignored that policy.

## Why This Change Was Made

The xAI video provider now sanitizes `cfg.models.providers.xai.request` and passes it into the existing provider HTTP resolver used by the create, poll, and download flow. The poll and download flow now always uses the guarded provider fetch path; private-network access is enabled only when explicitly configured. The change leaves generation parameters, polling semantics, idempotency headers, and media parsing unchanged.

## User Impact

Users who depend on configured provider transport policy can expect xAI video generation to honor those request settings. With no request policy, provider-controlled xAI video status/download URLs now stay on the default SSRF-protected path instead of being fetched through an unguarded fallback.

## Evidence
Additional exact-head local controlled transport proof (redacted):

- Head: `9ed880e8aa71`
- Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts --reporter verbose`
- Result: passed, 1 file / 3 tests.
- Observed transcript:

```text
RUN v4.1.9 <repo>

✓ extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts > xai video generation provider transport > uses configured policy for xAI API requests without leaking headers to video downloads
✓ extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts > xai video generation provider transport > blocks default loopback xAI video requests before reaching the server
✓ extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts > xai video generation provider transport > blocks explicit false loopback xAI video requests before reaching the server

Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       3 passed (3)
```

Observation: the exact-head controlled loopback transport proof covers configured-policy forwarding plus zero loopback server reachability for both unset/default request policy and explicit `allowPrivateNetwork: false`. This is local controlled proof, not a live xAI provider run.

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 19 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude --model claude-fable-5 --thinking high` reported no accepted/actionable findings.

### 2026-07-12 follow-up: local controlled request-policy proof

- Commit `523f5999e4` fixes the review gap by passing the resolved xAI request policy through video create, poll, and generated-video download. The poll/download stages now use guarded provider fetches when `allowPrivateNetwork` or a dispatcher/proxy policy is configured, while preserving the existing unconfigured fast path and bounded xAI JSON/media readers.
- Local focused proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts` passed: 19 tests.
- The focused regression now asserts the configured header, explicit private-network opt-in, and dispatcher policy are visible on all three changed stages: create submit, status poll, and generated-video download.
- This is controlled local provider-path proof only. No live xAI API call was made and no real xAI account, proxy, or media generation was exercised.


### 2026-07-13 follow-up: default-deny SSRF guard repair

- Current head `0ba4e54026` includes `3edeec9ec3` and removes the unguarded xAI video poll/download fallback. `fetchXaiVideoResponse` now always calls `fetchWithTimeoutGuarded`; `allowPrivateNetwork` is passed only when explicitly true, and dispatcher policy/header behavior remains preserved.
- Added controlled local transport proof for both unset request policy and explicit `request.allowPrivateNetwork: false`: each case points xAI `baseUrl` at a local loopback HTTP server and asserts `server.requests` remains `0`, proving the guard blocks before the server receives a connection.
- Local lightweight check run by the maintainer agent: `git diff HEAD --check` — passed.
- Not run locally: focused Vitest, because this is contributor/fork source and the current agent policy uses secretless fork CI/sanitized remote proof for untrusted code execution. The pushed head is expected to run the added transport/unit tests in GitHub CI.
- Merge/update note: `17ad46ac16` merges latest `upstream/main` into the branch with the `provider-http-mocks.ts` conflict resolved by keeping the current SDK `dispatcherPolicy` return type while preserving the xAI guarded-fetch mock support.
- CI repair note: `0ba4e54026` removes unused test helper code and restores the mocked `fetchWithTimeout` timeout assertion type after the main merge.

## Proof

### 2026-07-12 exact-head local transport proof after CI-refresh update-branch

- Exact head tested after normal `gh pr update-branch`: `4ffb626175e89d694394ae655a69128245807ef0`.
- Scope: controlled local provider-path proof for xAI video generation create, poll, and generated-video download. This is not a live xAI API call.
- Commands run:

  ```bash
  git fetch fork alix/xai-request-policy-video-generation --no-tags
  git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  git rev-parse HEAD
  git diff --check
  node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts
  node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.test.ts
  ```

- Result: PASS. `git diff --check` passed; focused oxlint exited 0; Vitest passed 1 shard, 2 files, 20 tests in 22.02s total wall time. Vitest duration: 14.47s.
- Transcript excerpt:

  ```text
  HEAD is now at 4ffb626175 Merge branch 'main' into alix/xai-request-policy-video-generation
  4ffb626175e89d694394ae655a69128245807ef0
  Test Files  2 passed (2)
  Tests  20 passed (20)
  [test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 22.02s
  ```

- Observation: `extensions/xai/video-generation-provider.transport.test.ts` starts a local HTTP server and drives the real provider path through video create, poll, and generated-video download. The configured `X-Xai-Trace` header and Authorization header reach only xAI API-origin create/poll requests; the generated-video download request is a plain `GET` and does not include the custom header or Authorization. The companion unit test also asserts the download init remains headerless and the provider no longer overrides request-policy private-network opt-in with caller-level `allowPrivateNetwork:false`.
- Not tested: no live xAI account, real API key, external proxy/TLS route, real video generation job, or external provider endpoint was exercised.
